concept.heading: Core Pattern
concept.body: Binary search halves the search space each iteration. Works when the space is **monotonic** (sorted, or has a property like TTTFFFF). Two main types:
bullets: **Search in sorted array:** Classic binary search on values
**Search on answer:** Binary search on the answer space. "Can we achieve X?" If yes, try smaller. If no, try bigger.

problems.title: Search a 2D Matrix
problems.keyInsight: Treat the 2D matrix as a flattened sorted 1D array. Index i maps to row = i // cols, col = i % cols.

problems.title: Koko Eating Bananas
problems.keyInsight: Binary search on eating speed k (1 to max(piles)). For each k, check if Koko can finish in h hours. Find minimum valid k.

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.keyInsight: If nums[mid] > nums[right], the minimum is in the right half (rotation point is there). Otherwise, minimum is in the left half including mid.

problems.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.keyInsight: At least one half is always sorted. Check which half is sorted, then check if target falls in that sorted range.

problems.title: Time Based Key-Value Store
problems.keyInsight: Store (timestamp, value) pairs in a list per key. Since timestamps are always increasing, binary search for the largest timestamp ≤ given timestamp.

problems.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
problems.keyInsight: Binary search on the shorter array to find a partition where all left elements ≤ all right elements. The partition point gives us the median.
